candidates.hook: Blond Nobleman shouts “This man is an imposter! Arrest him!”
candidates.cliffhanger: Cuts just before Alexander declares “Then let the Crown decide.” – the audience wonders what evidence he will reveal.
candidates.why: Immediate accusation, guard defiance and a looming reveal create high tension in a compact 21‑second arc.

candidates.hook: Alexander coldly says “Then let the Crown decide.”
candidates.cliffhanger: Ends right before the Crown Official announces “The report identifies the leak as deliberate.” – viewers are left hanging on the damning accusation.
candidates.why: Shows the power shift and the first glimpse of the incriminating dossier, then stops at the moment the betrayal is about to be exposed.

candidates.hook: Police Constable blocks Lord Sterling with “Going somewhere, Lord Sterling?”
candidates.cliffhanger: Cuts after the constable’s line, before Lord Sterling’s terrified close‑up – the audience wonders if he will escape or be captured.
candidates.why: A high‑stakes chase moment that instantly raises danger and ends on a perfect suspense beat.

moments.desc: Blond Nobleman shouts “This man is an imposter! Arrest him!”
Guard Captain raises sword and declares “We will not.”
Crown Official reads the damning name “Lord Henry Sterling.”
Police Constable confronts fleeing Lord Sterling: “Going somewhere, Lord Sterling?”
